mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 41 degrees at Reddan Soccer Park under clear skies. The ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

The City of Verona has announced that Phase 2 of the Mark Drive reconstruction project is underway. This project is replacing water mains, sanitary sewers, and adding new sidewalks between North Nine Mound Road and Westlawn Avenue, with completion planned for next spring.

We have a packed schedule of trivia today at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, and Paddy Mac's. Looking ahead to tomorrow, check out live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, and more trivia nights at The Mill and The Bogey Factory.
In a notable service call from October 25, officers arrested a 40-year-old Verona man for O W I after he was discovered stationary at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue.
Today's flavor of the day is Chocolate Heath Crunch. The store opens today at 10:00 AM, so be sure to stop by for a scoop.
